annotations.text:
SHELL & WORKPLACE

Every screen is built from the tokens already in the app — brand #1b5df5, slate neutrals, 12px card radii, the same shadow, and the uppercase 12px table headers from src/components/ui.

The sidebar is new. It expands (Home) and collapses to an icon rail (every other board), because staff screens need the width.

The brand accent is a tweak chip above each artboard — that is the per-school brand colour, so you can see any school's palette instantly.

MODULES & CONFIGURATION

Staff forum: 3-pane — categories, thread list, thread. Reported posts raise a moderation task rather than sitting in a separate queue.

Resource library: digital only, per your decision. No loans, due dates or fines. Filters are subject / type / level / access.

School setup: the Grading tab is open because it is the heart of multi-tenancy — a school picks a published scheme or defines its own bands, and the contiguity check runs before save.

K-12 REPORT CARD

Drawn at true A4 (794×1123 at 96dpi), so Export PDF gives a real printable page — report cards get handed to parents.

It reads from the same configured grade bands as the university transcript; only the presentation differs. That is what the academicModel switch buys.

Placeholder content throughout — names, marks and remarks are invented.
